blocks.text: Team preview of the Denver Nuggets ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 54-28, lost to Minnesota in first round of playoffs. Coach: David Adelman (2nd season as full-time coach, 57-28). Season opener: Oct. 22 at Oklahoma City. Departures: G/F Tim Hardaway Jr., C Jonas Valanciunas, G Bruce Brown, G/F Peyton Watson. Additions: F/C Marvin Bagley III, G/F DeMar DeRozan, G Alpha Diallo, G Ryan Nembhard, F Cam Whitmore, G Lonnie Walker IV. What to expect The Nuggets are once again running it back and hoping for better health come playoff time. Last season, Aaron Gordon and Peyton Watson […]...
